_about: Per-language tools Swan runs after edits: linters (into get_diagnostics; they must not write into the repo, so their caches are off), formatters (format_file) and test runners (run_tests), which act on the repo by design. Each kind is a list of candidates; the first whose conditions hold is used. when_file: one of these exists in the repo. when_cmd: this command exits 0. Placeholders: {repo}, {python} (the repo's virtualenv, else python3), {tools} (Swan's .tools), {bin} (Swan's tools/node_modules/.bin), {out} (the map folder), {files} and {tests} (one argument each; a candidate needing them is skipped when there are none). parser: how output becomes diagnostics (github: ::error file=..,line=..,col=..::message; cargo: cargo's JSON lines). lsp: a language server swan serve keeps running for live answers (get_diagnostics and find_implementations with live): language_id for didOpen, init the initializationOptions as a JSON string (placeholders expanded).
